Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 134. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Weapon Technique
Ki Cost: 24 Ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Weapon
that you are proficient with
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Weapon’s Range
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: Yes
You form small fireballs that follows right alongside
your attacks. Make a Combo Attack. On a hit, you deal
your weapon’s damage die + 6d6 fire damage. On a hit,
creature must make a Constitution Saving Throw, on a
failure, they take 4d6 fire damage at the start of their
next turn.
They must repeat this saving throw at the start of
their turn until they succeed.
